fields.name: pm01
fields.description: PM1.0 raw mass concentration of particles <= 1µm diameter

fields.name: pm01Standard
fields.description: PM1.0 standard mass concentration (CF=1 standard particle)

fields.name: pm01Count
fields.description: PM1.0 particle count per 0.1L air

fields.name: pm02
fields.description: PM2.5 raw mass concentration of particles <= 2.5µm diameter

fields.name: pm02Standard
fields.description: PM2.5 standard mass concentration (CF=1 standard particle)

fields.name: pm02Compensated
fields.description: PM2.5 corrected/calibrated value adjusted for humidity and environmental factors

fields.name: pm02Count
fields.description: PM2.5 particle count per 0.1L air

fields.name: pm10
fields.description: PM10 raw mass concentration of particles <= 10µm diameter. Less reliable than PM2.5 on Plantower sensors.

fields.name: pm10Standard
fields.description: PM10 standard mass concentration (CF=1 standard particle)

fields.name: pm10Count
fields.description: PM10 particle count per 0.1L air

fields.name: pm003Count
fields.description: Count of particles >= 0.3µm diameter per 0.1L air. Reveals pollution events mass-based PM may miss.

fields.name: pm005Count
fields.description: Count of particles >= 0.5µm diameter per 0.1L air

fields.name: pm50Count
fields.description: Count of particles >= 5.0µm diameter per 0.1L air

fields.name: rco2
fields.description: CO2 raw concentration in parts per million. Standard unit for tracking CO2 buildup from human activity.

fields.name: atmp
fields.description: Temperature raw reading near sensor. For indoor monitors, reflects ambient room temperature well.

fields.name: atmpCompensated
fields.description: Temperature corrected/calibrated value adjusted for sensor and environmental factors.

fields.name: rhum
fields.description: Relative humidity raw reading. Indicates water vapor content relative to air saturation.

fields.name: rhumCompensated
fields.description: Relative humidity corrected/calibrated value adjusted for sensor and environmental factors.

fields.name: tvocIndex
fields.description: TVOC index (1-500). 100=baseline, >100=more VOCs than 24h baseline, <100=fewer VOCs. Adapts sensitivity based on environment.

fields.name: tvocRaw
fields.description: TVOC raw log resistance from MOx sensor. Reducing gases (VOCs) lower resistance. Broadband, non-specific output.

fields.name: noxIndex
fields.description: NOx index (1-500). 1=baseline, >1=more oxidizing gases present. No gain adaptation unlike TVOC.

fields.name: noxRaw
fields.description: NOx raw log resistance from MOx sensor. Oxidizing gases increase resistance. General oxidizing gas presence, not specific concentrations.

fields.name: wifi
fields.description: WiFi signal strength in dBm. Useful for monitoring device connectivity health.

fields.name: boot
fields.description: Device boot counter. Tracks device restarts for reliability monitoring.

fields.name: bootCount
fields.description: Device boot counter (alias for boot field).

fields.name: serialno
fields.description: Device serial number for identification.

fields.name: firmware
fields.description: Device firmware version.

fields.name: model
fields.description: Device model identifier (e.g., I-9PSL for AirGradient One Indoor).

fields.name: ledMode
fields.description: Current LED display mode on device (e.g., co2, pm, off).

entity_schemas.description: AirGradient indoor air quality sensors (AG One I-9PSL, AG Pro). Based on official AirGradient parameter definitions.

attributes.name: pm01
attributes.description: PM1.0 raw mass concentration of particles <= 1µm

attributes.name: pm02
attributes.description: PM2.5 raw mass concentration of inhalable particles <= 2.5µm

attributes.name: pm02Compensated
attributes.description: PM2.5 corrected value adjusted using calibration formula

attributes.name: pm10
attributes.description: PM10 raw mass concentration. Plantower sensors optimized for PM2.5, making PM10 less reliable.

attributes.name: pm003Count
attributes.description: Count of particles >= 0.3µm. Reveals pollution events mass-based PM may miss.

attributes.name: rco2
attributes.description: CO2 raw concentration. PPM reflects volumetric gas concentration from human activity.

attributes.name: atmp
attributes.description: Temperature raw. For indoor monitors, reflects ambient room temperature well.

attributes.name: atmpCompensated
attributes.description: Temperature corrected for sensor and environmental factors.

attributes.name: rhum
attributes.description: Relative humidity raw. Water vapor content relative to air saturation.

attributes.name: rhumCompensated
attributes.description: Relative humidity corrected for sensor and environmental factors.

attributes.name: tvocIndex
attributes.description: TVOC index. 100=baseline, >100=more VOCs, <100=fewer VOCs vs 24h baseline. Adapts gain based on environment.

attributes.name: tvocRaw
attributes.description: TVOC raw log resistance from MOx sensor. Reducing gases lower resistance.

attributes.name: noxIndex
attributes.description: NOx index. 1=baseline, >1=more oxidizing gases. No gain adaptation unlike TVOC.

attributes.name: noxRaw
attributes.description: NOx raw log resistance from MOx sensor. Oxidizing gases increase resistance.

attributes.name: wifi
attributes.description: WiFi signal strength for connectivity monitoring.

attributes.name: boot
attributes.description: Device boot counter for reliability monitoring.

silver_etl.description: Indoor air quality measurements from AirGradient sensors
silver_etl.grain: One row per sensor reading (~1 minute intervals)

dq_rules.name: pm10_gte_pm25
dq_rules.expression: pm10 IS NULL OR pm25 IS NULL OR pm10 >= pm25
